name: F.B.I. (Finistère Business Investissements)
note: Breton hotel holding (SIREN 343493318, SA created 1987, 5 rue Colbert, Brest) that chairs the Oceania hotel companies: its conseil d'administration is entirely Branellec family (Francois Branellec administrateur, Gwenola Deguerre-Branellec Présidente du conseil d'administration, Gurvan Branellec and Rozenn Dumon-Branellec directeurs généraux délégués), and its subsidiary Sofibra (SIREN 997635123) has the same all-family board. No state or fund stake found.
